tables.name: Publications Table
tables.description: A simple data table showing research publications with year, title, and status columns. Uses minimal styling with subtle row borders.
when_to_use: Simple tabular data without complex interactions

tiles.name: Logo Garden Tile
tiles.description: Company logo display tiles arranged in a responsive grid. Each tile contains a centered SVG logo on a card background.

tiles.name: Feature Card
tiles.description: Large feature showcase cards with text content on one side and interactive demo media on the other. Uses subgrid for alignment.

tiles.name: Agent Sidebar Item
tiles.description: List item tiles in the agent sidebar showing task status with icons, titles, and metadata. Supports in-progress, ready for review states.
